text: **Verified**: Compared the API documentation in `docs/api.md` against the implementation in `src/api.js` and `src/limit.js`. Identified six critical mismatches spanning API version (`/v1` vs `/v2`), POST response code (`201` vs `202`), pagination method (offset vs cursor-based, 50 vs 25 per page), undocumented POST requirements, missing bearer token authentication, and rate limit values (100/min documented vs 600/min implemented, per-token vs per-IP). Assessment written to ASSESSMENT.md without modifying any code or documentation.
